item.title: Paleografia Quantitativa Norditalica (PQN): Mathematical evidence for a full grapho-phonological integration of the runes into North Italic alpbabets
item.description: The collective GEAS project called PQN (Paleografia Quantitativa Norditalica) depicts every single graphic shape of the Lepontic/Brembonic/Cisalpine-Celtic, Raetic/Camunic, and Etruscan/Lemnic sub-alphabets…. and the Elder Futhark. Excerpt from the 40-page long PQN tables with several thousand sign variants in North Italic and Germanic writing. Graphemes which are identical according to the GEAS standards are listed on the same line. From the 125 listed variants of runes, 76 are identical, 49 are similar and none is different.
